description: This file implements JSON schema validation logic using the AJV library, including schema caching, error formatting, and default value application.

classes.name: AjvLike
classes.description: Interface for AJV-like validator objects with methods to add formats and compile schemas.

classes.name: CachedValidator
classes.description: Structure holding a compiled validation function and its schema.

methods.name: getAjv
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a cached AJV validator instance based on mode ('default' or 'defaults').

methods.name: cloneValidationValue
methods.description: Performs a deep clone of the validation value, respecting null and undefined.

methods.name: normalizeAjvPath
methods.description: Normalizes AJV error instance paths to a dot-separated string.

methods.name: appendPathSegment
methods.description: Appends a segment to a path, handling root path case.

methods.name: resolveMissingProperty
methods.description: Resolves the missing property name from certain AJV error objects.

methods.name: resolveAjvErrorPath
methods.description: Constructs the full error path including missing property if applicable.

methods.name: extractAllowedValues
methods.description: Extracts allowed values from AJV error objects for enum or const keywords.

methods.name: getAjvAllowedValuesSummary
methods.description: Summarizes allowed values from AJV error objects.

methods.name: formatAjvErrors
methods.description: Formats AJV validation errors into a standardized array of validation error objects.

methods.name: validateJsonSchemaValue
methods.description: Validates a value against a schema, applying defaults if specified, with schema caching.
